prose: Latent Space's AI Engineer podcast tees up Thariq Shihipar of Anthropic to discuss Claude Code's next era, with a recap of Anthropic's blistering 2026: the largest fundraise of all time in May at $47B ARR, then Claude Tag, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 5, /checkup, crossing $65B ARR, Fable/Mythos 5.1, an IPO target of $2T with end-2026 ARR estimated at $100B, merged cowork/chat, Claude Mods (someone already built Tetris-in-Claude), Dario cosigning the Pacing the Frontier message, Opus 5.5, the plugins portal, Cloud Sessions/Claude Projects, and now Sonnet 5.5. The episode also name-checks Thariq's viral inverse observation: there's a 'make a lot of money' button nobody is pressing - take your SaaS, make it headless, let agents use it, and charge per interaction, especially for enterprises.
highlights: Thariq Shihipar (Anthropic) on Claude Code's next era at AI Engineer New York
Recap: from $47B ARR at the May fundraise to an estimated $100B ARR by end of 2026
Claude Mods are landing; someone already built a Tetris-in-Claude mod
Dario endorsed the Pacing the Frontier message cosigned by all labs
Thariq's viral take: the unpressed 'make a lot of money' button is headless SaaS for agents, priced per interaction
quotes: weird that there's a "make a lot of money" button
